explication: Gluten is a Spark SQL middle layer that delegates eligible physical-plan work to native engines while retaining Spark’s distributed execution and fallback control flow. The main workflow converts Spark plans for backend execution, exchanges columnar batches across the JVM/native boundary, and returns results through Spark’s columnar APIs. The tree shows Bolt and ClickHouse integration, with memory managers for Bolt and Velox; README-documented plan conversion, fallback, metrics, and shuffle capabilities are represented where supported. Excerpts are partial, so uncertain call wiring is omitted.
